serialization: UTF-8 JSONL, exactly one canonical serialized record per declared window; SHA-256 over raw bytes; rational strings n/d in lowest terms with positive denominator

producer_manifest_required.vertices_edges_pairs_orientation: labeled and oriented bases plus A=(01,23), B=(02,13), C=(03,12)
producer_manifest_required.producer: name, organization, independence declaration, authorship/access history, kind independent_model|measurement
producer_manifest_required.custodian: identity, access control and trusted receipt method
producer_manifest_required.source_version_and_sha256: code/protocol, dependencies, raw source and signed-G computation
producer_manifest_required.endpoint_producer_version_and_sha256: separate code/protocol and raw endpoint evidence
producer_manifest_required.clock: native dimensionless interval definition or separate calibrated physical mapping
producer_manifest_required.window_range_and_sampling: first/last consecutive index, acquisition cadence, handling of skipped/missing windows
producer_manifest_required.eligibility_exclusion_tie_simultaneity: rules and code hash fixed without outcomes
producer_manifest_required.transport_route: source-complete ordered six-edge or certified observed/co-moving 12D
producer_manifest_required.claim_scope: finite same-carrier comparison; no automatic physical promotion

pre_event_row_required.cohort_id_window_id_sequence_index: stable IDs and consecutive integer index
pre_event_row_required.s_start_s_end: exact rationals and complete exposure window
pre_event_row_required.raw_c0_c1_c2: ordered exact cochain values with raw acquisition hash; c3 if model uses it
pre_event_row_required.theta_minus_raw: three binary values in source pair basis
pre_event_row_required.frame_pre_receipt: signed S4 action, S3 pair projection and exact certificate or typed HOLD
pre_event_row_required.transport_pre_receipt: ordered six-edge maps or certified 12D M,O,residual; typed HOLD if unavailable
pre_event_row_required.lineage_and_seat_pre_receipt: independently frozen F,A_src,A_ren, domain/codomain, L+ and rank/support; typed HOLD if unavailable
pre_event_row_required.viability_pair_integrity_burden: separate pre-outcome receipts in both relevant bases
pre_event_row_required.signed_G_by_pair: exact values and raw c0,c1,c2 formula/integration/normalization provenance; typed HOLD if unavailable
pre_event_row_required.eligible_before_outcome: boolean plus frozen rule/version and reason, never derived from endpoint
pre_event_row_required.state_receipt_sha256: hex digest of raw state and pre-event record

hidden_endpoint_row_required.s_start_s_end: same interval; independent instant or explicit NO_SWITCH receipt
hidden_endpoint_row_required.output_frame_full: signed oriented frame and exact observation/generation receipt
hidden_endpoint_row_required.theta_plus_full: three binary values in named output pair basis
hidden_endpoint_row_required.event_instant_or_null_receipt: exact instant/uncertainty or entire observed no-event interval
hidden_endpoint_row_required.closure_transport_post_receipts: primitive typed edge U_e/closure evidence if six-edge claims; otherwise OUT_OF_SCOPE
hidden_endpoint_row_required.uncertainty_and_measurement_method: instrument/model limitations and raw evidence location
hidden_endpoint_row_required.target_receipt_sha256: hex digest for raw independent endpoint evidence

custody_ledger_row_required.trusted_utc_receipt: external timestamp/signature and provenance, not sole local clock
custody_ledger_row_required.parent_action_digest: hash link to preceding custody receipt
custody_ledger_row_required.access_policy_and_version: who could read the plaintext at this step

blocking_rule: HOLD is neither null nor zero. Any missing row blocks cohort completeness; required field HOLD blocks full endpoint score for that row and is enumerated in denominators. No labels released before prediction seal.
